facts.text: hot food at last, aboard the drifting station
facts.why: The crew scavenge a derelict station and the film shows no hot meal or katsu curry, so 'hot food at last' is unproven.
facts.fix: hot food before they board the derelict station

vibe.verdict: Cold, grim colony canteen with Andy's jokes and Rain's sun dream in the right places, but the big set pieces are missing.
